links.outcome: Citation relevance and hallucination robustness of AI literature summaries across five tools
links.effect: VarChat ranked highest on accuracy, citation relevance and hallucination robustness; GPT-4o second; Perplexity and ScholarAI, despite being literature-focused, ranked lowest across most metrics.
links.quote: VarChat emerged as the top-ranked tool, showing the highest summarization accuracy, citation relevance, and robustness against hallucinations.

links.outcome: Reliability of AI-generated genomic variant literature summaries as judged by blinded domain experts
links.effect: Tool performance varied widely and was sensitive to literature scarcity; authors conclude reliable integration requires expert validation and domain-related fine-tuning.
links.quote: While some platforms already provide useful outputs, reliable integration into basic and clinical research requires expert validation and domain-related fine-tuning.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and benchmarks multiple generative AI tools for literature retrieval and summarization in clinical genomics via blind expert evaluation, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
